My dear [Miss Compton](/person/364)
Would you be so kind as to answer this lady, as you understand the [Reading Union](/organisation/211) much better than I do

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: Agnes Charlotte Compton (b. 1863), daughter of the Rev.

John Compton, Rector of Minstead with Lyndhurst.
[^2]: Envelope postmarked Winchester 2.45.PM Ap 18 96 and addressed ‘Miss A C Compton/Rectory/ Minstead/Lyndhurst’ and forwarded to ‘c/o Canon Lucas/Shortlands/Kent’.
